result.summary: The recorded 2026 claims (TIME on internal AGI and the September and October items) were seen only in news coverage, not in his own words. The one new dated line I could read on an opened page is a 12-month progress forecast from Invest Like the Best, in a low-quality machine transcript and borderline as a prediction about AI. Strong leads I could not verify: the 'ChatGPT moment for robotics in two or three years' remark from the same podcast, the Singularity University Summit 'next six months' quote, and the India summit superintelligence and 2028 remarks, which Digit gives only as paraphrase.

reply_text:
I found one new dated prediction for 2026, and it's a weak one. I also found nothing that clearly matches any of your eight recorded claims, though one paraphrase may cover the same ground as the late-2028 file.

**The candidate:** On Invest Like the Best (EP.484, July 2026), Altman says OpenAI's progress "will be much more remarkable over the next 12 months." Three caveats:
- **Weak source.** The text comes from a third-party machine transcript with obvious errors ("chat GBT", "Hall of Pain" for the "jalapeño" chip, "Kimmy"/"Chemie" for Kimi). It is not an official transcript, so check the quote against the audio before using it.
- **Borderline wording.** He's talking about OpenAI's own progress, so you may decide it isn't really a prediction about AI.
- **Uncertain date.** The July 28 date comes only from search listings; the page I opened shows no date.

**Seen but not usable as quotes:**
- **Robots in two or three years.** Several search results say that in the same podcast Altman expects a "ChatGPT moment" for robotics "in the next two or three years." The transcript page cut off before that part, and I had no page openings left. It's the strongest lead still open.
- **Singularity University Summit, July 2026.** News reports quote him saying models will progress faster in the next six months than in the past two years. The only report I tried wouldn't open.
- **India AI Impact Summit speech, 19 February.** Digit reports, in its own words only, that he expects an early form of superintelligence "within the next few years" and more intellectual output inside data centres than outside by the end of 2028. The 2028 point may be the same claim as your file dated 2026-03-11 (more thinking capacity in data centres by late 2028), but the dates differ by three weeks, so I left the matching field empty.
- **Fortune interview (5 October).** The "10% risk … by the end of the decade" line is the writer's paraphrase of his reply to other people's estimates, not his forecast. His one quoted "I think that will happen" is about lab leaders meeting, not about AI.
- **Stripe Sessions (29 April).** The part of the transcript I read had no dated AI prediction.

One process note: in my first round I printed the page text but didn't save it, so I spent my sixth and last page opening re-opening the podcast transcript.
